text_block_list.text:
While walking in front of the station,
I happened to spot Mejiro McQueen.
She seemed to be staring intently at a poster—
choice_data_list: ("Write a fight song for the Victories"?)

text_block_list.text:
The poster was an announcement from a professional baseball team.
Apparently, they were holding an open call for lyrics for their cheer song,
but what was it about it that caught her eye...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(A fight song for the Victories... It feels presumptuous
of me to submit one, but... even so...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Th-There should be no harm in just writing it down, desu wa...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The passion felt in the stadium, every single play given heart and soul.
I shall express my feelings for the Victories in my own way—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Found ya, McQueen!
Let's do tug-of-war with freshly harvested slimy kelp!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Carry our dreams upon that single swing,
Give it your all"... No, "Bearing our hopes", it is.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's this, what's this~? So focused on that—
Don't tell me you're penning the Golshi-chan Quotations Bible?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go, Victories!
Wow Wow Victories!"
............Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Knock it outta the paaaark, G-o-l-s-h-i ♡

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek~?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well well, Mac-chan writing lyrics for a fight song~.
Turning into such a bold girl while I wasn't looking...
*sniffle* *sob*

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A-A fight song, you say?!
I haven't the slightest clue what you are talking about!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come on now~, it's that public contest thingy, right?
You can't fool Golshi-chan's dewy, glistening eyes☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...N-No, it is not!
I am merely jotting down my thoughts and feelings—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heh, huh, hmmmm~?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then this notebook is mine!
I'll be using it for the Golden Golshies!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Eh?!
Gold Ship-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on right there!
Give me back my notebook!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No waaay! I've got the supreme Starting Nine assembled!
All we need is a fight song and a cheering squad, and our youth shall begin!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come on out, Golden-Voiced Whale~~!!
Sing us this cheer song in your rich baritone voice~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Why on earth would there be a whale in a field?!
Please cease this nonsense at once~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...!
Return it... at once! That is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It belongs to the Victories!
Filled with my deepest feelings, written solely for the Victories...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh.
Guess you just hit a soulful out-of-the-park home run on me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Guess I got no choice. If you're gonna say that much, throw a complete game!
I'll even write "Pour your soul into every pitch" right on the brim of your cap!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship... san...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Could it be that she was trying to give me a push...?
No, but surely not, coming from her—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
............
Nevertheless, my resolve is set.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
~~~!
I-I went and submitted it, desu wa!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, good job! Good job!
Want a soda can tab blessed by Lady Golshi herself?
Stick it on your forehead and acceptance is guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Spouting nonsense again...
Yet, it is a fact that I was aided by your whimsical nature.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps just this once, I will take you up on that offer.
...Gold Ship-san, would you show me your forehead?

—Previously, Mejiro McQueen had been brooding in front of the poster.
Today, however, when I saw her on campus, she wore a radiant and bright expression.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...My mind is made up, yet still,
I should wait until my heart is fully prepared—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, is the batter getting cold feet~??
Once you step into the batter's box, all that's left is to swing!
Sheesh.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Pinch hitter: Uniform #564, Golshi-chan!
With a powerful swing—*click*☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah?!
Y-You... What are you doing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Honestly... You really are something............ Fufu.

—Previously, Mejiro McQueen had been brooding in front of the poster.
Today, however, when I saw her on campus, she wore a radiant and bright expression.
